events.label: founding
events.text: Municipality of Gamvik established when old Tana Municipality was divided.

evidence.quote: The municipality of Gamvik was established on 1 January 1914

events.text: Construction started for a landside terminal and a SOSUS cable into the sea

evidence.quote: In June 1972 construction started for [ a landside terminal and ] running a SOSUS cable

events.label: air crash
events.text: Widerøe Twin Otter LN-BNK crashed into the sea near Mehamn, killing all fifteen on board

evidence.quote: On 12 March 1982 , a Widerøe Twin Otter , registration number LN-BNK , crashed into the sea near Mehamn , killing all fifteen on board

events.label: coat of arms granted
events.text: Municipal coat of arms granted, showing three fishing net needles.
Trond Einar Olaussen (Ap) begins term as mayor.
Trond Einar Olaussen's term as mayor ends.
Alf Normann Hansen (SV) begins term as mayor.
Gamvik becomes part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county.

evidence.quote: On 1 January 2020 , the municipality became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county

undated_mentions: Gamvik was previously part of the old Finnmark county (no date given)
